description: This file defines quota management for the etcd storage backend, including quota interfaces, implementations, and functions to create and evaluate storage quotas based on backend size and request types.

classes.name: passthroughQuota
classes.description: A quota implementation that always allows requests with no cost.

classes.name: BackendQuota
classes.description: A quota implementation based on a backend storage size limit.

methods.name: Available
methods.description: Checks if a request fits within the quota.

methods.name: Cost
methods.description: Calculates the cost of a request against the quota.

methods.name: NewBackendQuota
methods.description: Creates a new quota object with specified backend size limit.
